name: Fujikawa Mia
source:
The main heroine.

Mia has a vigilant cat-like face and rarely smiles. 

However, she deeply trusts the people she approves. 
A mysterious girl who doesn't talk about her past.

Contrary to her childish appearance, she behaves in a mature manner. Has a personal view on pollock roe.

Favorites: Collecting lip creams, pollock roe
